name: light_door_spill
kind: light texture (PointLight2D): the wedge of light through the parents' opening door (the caught moment)
scale_note: drawn at the true size: 1 texture px = 1 art px (texture_scale 0.4 in world px, 1 u = 32 world px = 80 art px). x 0-159 = the 160 px (2 u) door opening, 256 px = 3.2 u into her room. Whole-number scales only (brief 04).
anchor_row0: row 0 = the threshold's N edge (door_frame.png row 25, the parents' side); x 0 = the opening's left edge (the hinge jamb). PointLight2D centres its texture: offset = (80, 128) art px from that corner, i.e. the light node sits 80 px right of the hinge jamb and 128 px into her room, or set `offset` accordingly
direction: +y: the light falls from the door into her room. Hinge on the LEFT (door_leaf pivot (0, 27)); the leaf swings into the parents' room, so the light comes through the gap at the latch jamb. flip_h for a door hinged on the right; rotate for doors in other walls
design: option B 'door ajar' (critic pick; A wide open / C narrow blade in review/light_door_spill_options(_3x).png): leaf ~36 deg open, a 55 px gap at the latch jamb widening to ~136 px; both sides straight and hard (latch jamb x 155 -> 160 and the leaf's free edge x 100 -> 24), meeting at the lamp behind the wall; band edges are arcs round that lamp, stepping down into the room; the far end two broad lobes
filter: nearest (project default_texture_filter 0), so the bands stay hard
playback_note: a suggestion (review/light_door_spill.gif): energy 0 -> 0.35 -> 0.7 -> 1.25 in ~90 ms steps as the leaf swings (or reveal it with the leaf's own angle), hold while parent_doorway_notice plays and the girl's caught holds, then fade
energy_note: at the tutorial ambient the two outer bands (#473e3c, #272323) barely show at energy 1.25 (for Beti: energy or a lighter far end; the band set is shared by every light)
